description:
Stunning 1, 2 and 3 Bedroom apartments available to rent in Dún Laoghaire. 

Set by the beautiful coastal suburb of Dún Laoghaire, Fairway Court is perfectly places only a short stroll from the waterfront and surrounded by amazing amenities and with great transport links into Dublin and beyond. 

Built for modern living, these fully furnished apartments are bright and airy and benefit from all the little touches that make life simply better. Open-plan living spaces, quality finishes throughout and a dedicated team onsite. All you need to do is move in.  

Standard Features of Fairway Court apartments include: 
- Contemporary, stylish and fully furnished interiors 
- Dedicated residents’ concierge service 
- Private gym
- Dedicated courtyard and residents’ playground 
- Dedicated work areas with free wifi 
- Car parking on site 

At Occu, we believe that renting should be better. That's why we're working hard to bring you the best: smarter, benefit focused and centred around the needs of our residents. No uncertainty, no hidden costs, stunning homes (and we'll let your pets move in too!). 
Better Renting. That's different. 

Please note: BER's range from A2-A3
